title: CIO.com Webinar
subject: CIO.com Webinar
body:
CIO.com WebinarCustomers are under pressure to modernize infrastructure while controlling cost, reducing complexity and supporting new business demands.

The CIO.com webinar, The Economics of Modern Storage Infrastructure: Lower Risk, Faster AI Value, Better ROI, gives you a strong way to start that conversation, with practical insight into how organizations can simplify hybrid operations, automate routine work and align infrastructure spend more closely to demand.

Use the webinar to help customers rethink where budget is going today and where modernization can create more value.

To help you take that message to market, the Data Platform, Architecture & Economics campaign is ready in the Partner Marketing Hub with co-brandable emails, social content and customer-facing assets.

Activate Campaign Now

Watch the webinar, activate the campaign and turn infrastructure complexity into new customer opportunities.

Thank you for being a valued partner!
Partner Marketing Team
